<!-- Source page: Swayosd -->

[SwayOSD](https://github.com/ErikReider/SwayOSD) is a OSD (On Screen Display) window for common actions such as volume, playback, and caps lock.

## Installation

SwayOSD may be installed simply by adding it into your configuration like so.

## Home Manager

SwayOSD has some options configurable in home manager, you may find them under [Home Manger - services.swayosd](https://nix-community.github.io/home-manager/options.xhtml#opt-services.swayosd.enable). You will need to bind the keys to use swayosd to perform actions. For more specific configuration options check the [swayosd github page](https://github.com/ErikReider/SwayOSD). The following configuration will set up the Volume Controls, Microphone Controls, Caps Lock, Brightness, and Media Controls through swayosd.
